title: MRTS PR #3 SonarQube Cloud validator signals are resolved by merged PR #4
title_de: Die SonarQube-Cloud-Validator-Signale von MRTS-PR #3 sind durch den gemergten PR #4 behoben
summary: Historical MRTS PR #3 failed with seven validator signals. MRTS PR #4 remediated the condition, passed all GitHub checks and SonarQube Cloud, and was merged as current main 615b13bacbd008562c17408246c41ab27dca3104; current live rechecks confirm zero vulnerabilities.
summary_de: Der historische MRTS-PR #3 scheiterte mit sieben Validator-Signalen. MRTS-PR #4 remedierte die Bedingung, bestand alle GitHub-Checks und SonarQube Cloud und wurde als aktueller main 615b13bacbd008562c17408246c41ab27dca3104 gemergt; aktuelle Live-Checks bestätigen null Vulnerabilities.
observed_behavior: Historical PR #3 failed new_security_rating with seven validator vulnerabilities. Remediation PR #4 head 9cdfd4136286014b244f8fecfb99701681fecae4 passed Analyze (python), CodeQL, Python 3.14 governance, and SonarCloud, then merged as main 615b13bacbd008562c17408246c41ab27dca3104. Current live PR #3, PR #4, and main rechecks report Quality Gate OK and zero vulnerabilities.
observed_behavior_de: Der historische PR #3 scheiterte an new_security_rating mit sieben Validator-Vulnerabilities. Remediation-PR #4 mit Head 9cdfd4136286014b244f8fecfb99701681fecae4 bestand Analyze (python), CodeQL, Python-3.14-Governance und SonarCloud und wurde anschließend als main 615b13bacbd008562c17408246c41ab27dca3104 gemergt. Aktuelle Live-Checks für PR #3, PR #4 und main melden Quality Gate OK und null Vulnerabilities.
expected_behavior: Current MRTS main retains a passing SonarQube Cloud Quality Gate and no open task-owned validator vulnerability without changing rules, the Quality Gate, exclusions, suppressions, false-positive dispositions, or security controls.
expected_behavior_de: Der aktuelle MRTS-main bewahrt ein bestehendes SonarQube-Cloud-Quality-Gate und keine offene aufgabeneigene Validator-Vulnerability ohne Änderung von Regeln, Quality Gate, Exclusions, Suppressions, False-Positive-Dispositionen oder Security-Controls.
impact: The former CI/quality-gate blocker is resolved. This closure applies only to the seven historical PR #3 validator signals and does not resolve unrelated SonarQube Cloud coverage or Framework findings.
impact_de: Der frühere CI-/Quality-Gate-Blocker ist behoben. Dieser Abschluss gilt nur für die sieben historischen Validator-Signale von PR #3 und löst keine unabhängigen SonarQube-Cloud-Coverage- oder Framework-Findings.
preconditions: The retained historical PR #3 receipt documents the former failure at e8bb04edf9e0cea03786e834c1f516f367d6136a.
MRTS PR #4 is merged as current main 615b13bacbd008562c17408246c41ab27dca3104.
The retained PR #4 and resulting-main receipts are hash-valid, and current public SonarQube Cloud and GitHub readbacks are available.
reproduction: The historical receipt proves the former PR #3 failure.
rtk gh pr checks 4 --repo Easton97-Jens/MRTS reports Analyze (python), CodeQL, Python 3.14 governance, and SonarCloud Code Analysis as passed.
PR #4 and main SonarQube Cloud Quality Gate and vulnerability receipts report status OK and zero vulnerabilities; current live rechecks confirm the same state.
root_cause: The original PR #3 validator shape triggered Sonar taint rules for local manifest paths. PR #4 applied the focused repository-native remediation and test coverage without weakening scanner rules, the Quality Gate, containment, symlink, remote, Gitlink, or cleanup controls.
root_cause_de: Die ursprüngliche PR-#3-Validator-Form löste Sonar-Taint-Regeln für lokale Manifest-Pfade aus. PR #4 wandte die fokussierte repository-native Remediation samt Testabdeckung an, ohne Scanner-Regeln, Quality Gate, Containment, Symlink-, Remote-, Gitlink- oder Cleanup-Controls abzuschwächen.
proposed_remediation: Completed by merged MRTS PR #4. Preserve the focused validator controls and tests; future changes require fresh exact-head SonarQube Cloud and GitHub-check evidence.
proposed_remediation_de: Durch den gemergten MRTS-PR #4 abgeschlossen. Die fokussierten Validator-Controls und Tests bleiben erhalten; künftige Änderungen brauchen frische Exact-Head-SonarQube-Cloud- und GitHub-Check-Evidence.
acceptance_criteria: MRTS PR #4 head 9cdfd4136286014b244f8fecfb99701681fecae4 passed Analyze (python), CodeQL, Python 3.14 governance, and SonarCloud Code Analysis.
The focused read-only, no-Git/no-shell/no-network/no-cleanup-execution and exact-cleanup invariants remain preserved by the retained PR #4 validation and tests.
PR #4 and resulting main 615b13bacbd008562c17408246c41ab27dca3104 report Quality Gate OK and zero open vulnerabilities.
No Sonar rule, Quality Gate, exclusion, false-positive disposition, NOSONAR marker, suppression, or security-control weakening was used.
validation_plan: Retain the historical failure, PR #4 exact-head, resulting-main, and local-validation receipts.
Inspect the merged PR #4/current-main GitHub state, all terminal PR checks, current SonarQube Cloud Quality Gates, and open vulnerability inventories.
For a future validator change, rerun the focused source/control/sink review and exact-head SonarQube Cloud/GitHub checks.
legitimate_control_tests: Analyze (python), CodeQL, Python 3.14 governance, and SonarCloud Code Analysis passed for MRTS PR #4.
The retained focused local validation passed 38 tests, Python compileall, and git diff --check for the PR #4 remediation.
Existing negative controls preserve metacharacter-safe argv, shell=False, and pre-Popen failures for missing configuration or test paths.

residual_risk: Future validator changes require fresh exact-head SonarQube Cloud and GitHub evidence. This closure does not resolve unrelated Framework coverage work in FND-SONAR-0009.
residual_risk_de: Künftige Validator-Änderungen brauchen frische Exact-Head-SonarQube-Cloud- und GitHub-Evidence. Dieser Abschluss löst die unabhängige Framework-Coverage-Arbeit in FND-SONAR-0009 nicht.
evidence_limitations: The closure is supported by retained PR #4/resulting-main receipts and current public SonarQube Cloud/GitHub readbacks. It does not establish a general security result for future validator changes or unrelated projects.

history.detail: Seven task-owned new scanner signals produce D new security rating; Analyze (python) and CodeQL passed.
Local tool-only surface and no-write contract are concrete counterevidence to the scanner's remote/HTTP exploit model; an external scanner disposition or scoped remediation remains a user decision.
MRTS PR #4 passed all four terminal checks, was Squash-merged as current main 615b13bacbd008562c17408246c41ab27dca3104, and retained PR/main receipts prove Quality Gate OK with zero vulnerabilities.
Current public PR #3, PR #4, project-main, and GitHub checks confirm the resolved state; the record is eligible for lossless local archival.
